WITH sma_10003_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) AS metric_time__day
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents ELSE 0 END AS __payment_cents
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS __refund_cents
  FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_source_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_8.payment_cents) AS payment_cents
  , MAX(subq_8.refund_cents) AS refund_cents
  , MAX(subq_15.refund_amount_rate) AS refund_amount_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(__payment_cents) AS payment_cents
    , SUM(__refund_cents) AS refund_cents
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_8
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    CAST(SUM(__refund_cents) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(__payment_cents), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS refund_amount_rate
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_15
